name: Island Folk Studio
subtitle: Onchain NFTs and editions
description: Example 2 — onchain-metadata ERC-721 plus finite-edition ERC-1155 sales. No IPFS, no external image gateways.
long_description: Two contracts, one pattern: keep the art on the chain. OnchainNFT packs four traits into a single storage slot per token and assembles JSON+SVG data URIs in view calls, so metadata never rots. Editions1155 lets a creator open a finite edition (cap, per-wallet limit, price, royalty bps); buyers pay the exact price and the creator withdraws proceeds — guarded by reentrancy protection, a solvency invariant, and an entry-only brake that never blocks withdrawals.
